description: Defines the CHistoryCollector class, which manages the collection and display of calculation history, including operands, operators, and commands within a calculator engine.

classes.name: CHistoryCollector
classes.description: A helper class for managing calculation history, including operands, operators, and commands, with methods for updating and retrieving history state.

methods.name: CHistoryCollector
methods.description: Constructor initializing history collector with display interfaces and decimal symbol.

methods.name: ~CHistoryCollector
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: AddOpndToHistory
methods.description: Adds an operand to the history with its string representation and rational value.

methods.name: RemoveLastOpndFromHistory
methods.description: Removes the last operand from the history.

methods.name: AddBinOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a binary operator to the history.

methods.name: ChangeLastBinOp
methods.description: Modifies the last binary operator in the history.

methods.name: AddUnaryOpToHistory
methods.description: Adds a unary operator to the history.

methods.name: AddOpenBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds an open brace to the history.

methods.name: AddCloseBraceToHistory
methods.description: Adds a close brace to the history.

methods.name: PushLastOpndStart
methods.description: Marks the start index of the last operand.

methods.name: PopLastOpndStart
methods.description: Removes the last operand start index.

methods.name: EnclosePrecInversionBrackets
methods.description: Encloses the current expression in inversion brackets.

methods.name: FOpndAddedToHistory
methods.description: Checks if an operand has been added to the history.

methods.name: CompleteHistoryLine
methods.description: Completes the current history line with a number string.

methods.name: CompleteEquation
methods.description: Completes the current equation with a number string.

methods.name: ClearHistoryLine
methods.description: Clears the current history line with an error string.

methods.name: AddCommand
methods.description: Adds an expression command to the history.

methods.name: UpdateHistoryExpression
methods.description: Updates the display of the history expression with radix and precision.

methods.name: SetDecimalSymbol
methods.description: Sets the decimal symbol used in the history.

methods.name: GetOperandCommandsFromString
methods.description: Creates operand commands from a string and rational value.

methods.name: GetCommands
methods.description: Retrieves the list of expression commands.
